meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of complaints filed with HUD; a filed case is an allegation, not a finding that discrimination occurred, and it is not a count of all housing discrimination (most is never reported). State and local fair housing agencies handle many complaints that never reach HUD. Rights and deadlines are for your own counsel.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.
